claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_turn_n
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Storm of Vengeance fires a distinct effect on each numbered turn of concentration (Turn 2: acid, Turn 3: lightning bolts, Turn 4: hail, Turns 5-10: cold+environmental). The current OngoingTrigger vocabulary has on_caster_turn_start which fires unconditionally every turn. There is no variant to express 'fire only on caster turn N of the concentration window', nor any mechanism for a sequenced/phased operation list where each entry fires at a specific turn offset.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of your later turns, the storm produces different effects, as detailed below. Turn 2: Acidic rain falls... Turn 3: You call six bolts of lightning... Turn 4: Hailstones rain down... Turns 5-10: Gusts and freezing rain assail the area...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 impose Difficult Terrain on the area for the remainder of the spell's duration. No effect atom exists in the current surface for creating difficult terrain in a zone. The existing movement atoms (modify_speed, set_speed, set_speed_ratio) operate on creatures, not on zones.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the area is Difficult Terrain and Heavily Obscured

claude_proposed_widenings.name: heavily_obscured
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 impose the Heavily Obscured condition on the area (SRD 5.2.1: creatures in a Heavily Obscured area effectively have the Blinded condition for sight-based checks). No effect atom exists for area-level visibility state. grant_condition_immunity / apply_condition operate on creatures, not zones.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the area is Difficult Terrain and Heavily Obscured

claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_ranged_weapon_attacks_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 make ranged attacks with weapons entirely impossible within the area. block_targeting per its SRD pressure cases (Globe of Invulnerability, Sanctuary) targets magical targeting of spells and abilities, not the physical viability of weapon attacks. Using block_targeting.scope as a free-form string here would be a false trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ranged attacks with weapons are impossible there

claude_proposed_widenings.name: strong_wind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 produce strong wind, which per SRD 5.2.1 Rules Glossary imposes disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made with weapons and Perception checks that rely on hearing, and extinguishes unprotected open flames. This is a named environmental state with multiple downstream effects. No atom captures a zone-level wind condition; the individual downstream effects (disadvantage on ranged attacks, disadvantage on hearing-based Perception) are partially coverable by modify_roll_advantage but the unified strong-wind state is not.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: strong wind blows through the area
